translationRepairs: The Chinese note is 〈（弟文耀）〉; the English already uses parentheses for （）, so the leftover book-title closer 〉 is stray source punctuation, not part of the translation.
Same stray 〉 on the literal field; removing it restores the English note without changing the kinship or name 弟文耀.
Li Laochai and Lone Wolf had seized the central region; grand coordinator Lian Guoshi and Yansui commander Wang Chengen laid siege to them.
Li Laochai and Lone Wolf had seized Zhongbu; grand coordinator Lian Guoshi and Yansui commander Wang Chengen laid siege to them.
陷中部 is the capture of Zhongbu county, which can then be 圍之; rendering 中部 as a vague 'central region' is a toponym error.
Li Laochai and Lone Wolf had overrun the central region; the grand coordinator Lian Guoshi and the Yansui commander Wang Chengen besieged them.
Li Laochai and Lone Wolf had overrun Zhongbu; the grand coordinator Lian Guoshi and the Yansui commander Wang Chengen besieged them.
The literal field has the same false gloss of 中部; Zhongbu is the place seized and then besieged.
The rebels had already beaten Deng Yin's force at Lin County; Wenzhao led five camps in a night attack and routed them.
The rebels had already beaten Deng Qi's force at Lin County; Wenzhao led five camps in a night attack and routed them.
鄧玘 is Deng Qi (玘 Qǐ). Yin is a wrong reading of 玘 and invents another general.
But the bandits had already defeated Deng Yin's troops at Lin County; Wenzhao led the five-camp army in a night raid and broke them.
But the bandits had already defeated Deng Qi's troops at Lin County; Wenzhao led the five-camp army in a night raid and broke them.
The literal field repeats Deng Yin for 鄧玘; Deng Qi is the correct name.
In the seventh month he routed the Huaqing rebels at Chailing Village, killed their chief Rolling Earth Dragon, and pursued Old Huihui to Jiyuan and killed him.
In the seventh month he routed the Huaiqing rebels at Chailing Village, killed their chief Rolling Earth Dragon, and pursued Old Huihui to Jiyuan and killed him.
懷慶 is the prefecture Huaiqing, not Huaqing; the rest of the sentence (柴陵村, 滾地龍, 老回回, 濟源) is unchanged.
In the seventh month he utterly defeated the Huaqing bandits at Chailing Village, beheaded their chieftain Rolling Earth Dragon, and again pursued and beheaded Old Huihui at Jiyuan.
In the seventh month he utterly defeated the Huaiqing bandits at Chailing Village, beheaded their chieftain Rolling Earth Dragon, and again pursued and beheaded Old Huihui at Jiyuan.
Same Huaiqing correction on the literal field for 懷慶.
At midnight Wenzhao led his nephew Bianjiao, garrison commander Dingjiao, and regional commander Bai Guang'en into the forest, routed the rebels, and pursued them to Jinling River.

At midnight Wenzhao led his nephews, assistant general Bianjiao and garrison commander Dingjiao, together with regional commander Bai Guang'en and others, routed the rebels in the deep forest, and pursued them to Jinling River.
從子 governs both 參將變蛟 and 守備鼎蛟; 等 includes Bai Guang'en with others; 敗賊深林中 is the fight in the deep forest. The original makes only Bianjiao a nephew, drops 參將, and omits 等.
The vanguard central commander Liu Honglie was captured; soon the deputy commanders Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen again died in battle.
The vanguard central commander Liu Honglie was captured; soon the deputy commanders Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen also died in battle.
After 劉弘烈被執, 復戰死 marks a further loss (also died in battle), not that Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen died a second time.
Only my troops are already divided, and there is no one who can plan support.
But my troops are already divided, and there is no one who can be sent in support.
顧 is adversative 'but', not 'only'; 策應 is sending support, not 'plan support'. The replacement matches 顧吾兵已分，無可策應者 and the following 為後勁.
His comrades only eyed him and laughed.
His comrades all eyed him and laughed.
同輩鹹目笑之 uses 鹹 for 咸 'all'. 'Only' reverses the comrades' shared mockery.

Along more than a thousand li of river the rebels could cross anywhere; Yuji posted troops on the upper reaches, left the lower crossing at Puyuan to grand coordinator Cai Maode, and asked the court for reinforcements.

Along more than a thousand li of river the rebels could cross anywhere; Yuji posted troops on the upper reaches, left the lower crossing at Puban to grand coordinator Cai Maode, and asked the court for reinforcements.
下流蒲阪 is the Yellow River crossing Puban (蒲坂/蒲阪), not Puyuan.

Yuji reasoned that along more than a thousand li of river the bandits could cross anywhere; he divided troops to hold the upper reaches and assigned the lower reaches at Puyuan to the grand coordinator Cai Maode, while requesting reinforcements from the court.

Yuji reasoned that along more than a thousand li of river the bandits could cross anywhere; he divided troops to hold the upper reaches and assigned the lower reaches at Puban to the grand coordinator Cai Maode, while requesting reinforcements from the court.
The literal field has the same false toponym Puyuan for 蒲阪; Puban is required.
Huang Degong, styled Tiger Mountain, was a native of Kaiyuan Guard; his family had moved from Hefei.
Huang Degong, sobriquet Hushan, was a native of Kaiyuan Guard; his family had moved from Hefei.
號虎山 is a hao, not a courtesy name (字), so 'styled' is wrong; Hushan is the name, and 'Tiger Mountain' is only a calque.
In Chongzhen 17 he was made Marquis Who Pacifies the South.
In Chongzhen 17 he was made Earl Who Pacifies the South.
十七年封靖南伯 is an earldom (伯). 進封侯 in the next sentence is the later promotion to marquis, so 'Marquis' here is the wrong rank.
In the seventeenth year he was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Pacifies the South.
In the seventeenth year he was enfeoffed as Earl Who Pacifies the South.
The literal field likewise calls 靖南伯 a marquis; Earl matches 伯, with 侯 only at 進封侯.
Kefa sent supervising general Wan Yuanji to mediate, but Degong would not agree.
Kefa sent the army supervisor Wan Yuanji to mediate, but a settlement could not be reached.
監軍 is an army supervisor, not a supervising general. 和解之，不可 reports that mediation failed without naming Degong as the sole refuser.
He moved his household to Taiping, devoted himself to fighting rebels, and was made Left Pillar of State for his merit.
He was ordered to move his household and garrison to Taiping and devote himself solely to dealing with the rebels; for his merit he was additionally made Left Pillar of State.
The original drops 命, 鎮, and 加. The proposal restores them but yokes the 論功加 clause onto the same 'ordered to' infinitives; the order is 移家鎮太平 and 一意辦賊, while 加左柱國 is a separate reward.
The commentator says: Cao Wenzhao and the others possessed fierce and valiant gifts; wherever they turned they crushed defeat, and all were called match for ten thousand men.
The commentator says: Cao Wenzhao and the others possessed fierce and valiant gifts; wherever they turned they crushed the enemy, and all were called a match for ten thousand men.
所向摧敗 means they crushed the enemy wherever they went; 'crushed defeat' inverts the object. Adding the article in 'a match for ten thousand men' is required English for 萬人敵.
